title: InstantSearchSSRProvider makes nested InstantSearch queries global
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

We have multiple nested `<InstantSearch />` to handle scenarios like carousels with specific filters and a typeahead function displaying hits before search query submission.

We use `<Configure />` (`useConfigure` in some cases) to handle these cases.

When we implemented `<InstantSearchSSRProvider />`, things started to get strange. For example, when users start inputing a search query, the route changes and apply the query with the global `<InstantSearch />`, even though its closest `<InstantSearch />` has no routing defined.

In the sandbox attached it's possible to see that ssr.tsx only differs on having `<InstantSearchSSRProvider />` wrapping the app.

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

1. In the Sandbox, search for "Nike" on the left panel and "Adidas" on the right
2. Confirm both columns are displaying independent hits
3. Open the SSR variation and repeat the same process
4. Notice that now both input fields are in sync, while they should not

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/s/delicate-cache-y2dj5v

### 💭 Expected behavior

Nested `<InstantSearch />` should set its children's components/hooks behaviors.

### Package version

"react-instantsearch-hooks-router-nextjs": "6.42.1",     "react-instantsearch-hooks-server": "6.42.1",     "react-instantsearch-hooks-web": "6.42.1"

### Operating system

macOS 12.6

### Browser

Brave 1.50.114
